blends.name: FRACTURED Akazu Blend
blends.desc:
**(Aka The Devil + Kazu The Merchant)**

The "Fractured Kumaverse" series is a bold and edgy new line of Krypto Kuma character designs that explores the idea of merging-universes. Each Krypto Kuma in this collection features a cracked, fragmented background, with glowing fissures that pulse with an evil energy.

Combine your favorite Krypto Kuma characters, and merge them into ALL NEW artworks!

WARNING: This capsule of evil energy may unlock the threads of space and time to create a unique combination known as a "Fractured-Kuma".
**[Collect Fracture Capsule Here](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/kryptokumas1/drops/224256)**

blends.name: Frankenstein Kuma | Animated CE GiF
blends.desc:
This is the Legendary Animated Frankenstein Kuma from the 2023 Vampire Apocalypse. Throughout the month of October, the Kumas must help Tokuma Village rid of the Vampire Apocalypse with the all new Kill-2-Collect!🩸

Using your ‘Bloody Stakes’ from the coffin packs, kill the apocalyptic Vampires to collect limited Halloween style Kuma characters.

**Needed for Blend:**
- 1 Bloody Stake

- 1 Frankenstein Kuma

- 25 Tokuma Token
